engineering.title: LinguaFlow: the AI engineering walkthrough
engineering.text: LinguaFlow is an English tutor built around a distinction: a model may know an answer without having a supporting teaching reference. This walkthrough focuses on the Study freeform system.

engineering.title: One concept. One retrieval chunk.
engineering.text: The repository contains two hundred teaching notes and one hundred seventy one English drills. Each note keeps its rule, examples, and boundaries together. Content validation and fingerprints make the index reproducible.

engineering.title: 10 vector candidates → 5 verifier candidates
engineering.text: A question and optional card become a query embedding. Postgres retrieves ten vector candidates. A heuristic reranker combines cosine similarity with normalized metadata, then sends the top five to verification. This is not B M twenty five fusion.

engineering.title: Verify scope, context, and evidence.
engineering.text: One verifier checks scope, missing context, and evidence support. It selects a supplied evidence identifier; the server restores the exact source text. Supported questions get a reference. Uncovered questions get a disclosure. Missing text triggers clarification.

engineering.title: Service errors are not successful abstentions.
engineering.text: Embeddings are prepared before atomic index publication. Readers check the active corpus fingerprint. In the freeform path, index and provider failures remain explicit service errors. Timeouts and bounded calls control failure behavior, without promising a production latency guarantee.

engineering.title: 100 questions. Two arms. Saved outputs.
engineering.text: The new evaluation compares verified and raw hybrid retrieval on one hundred frozen synthetic questions. Both arms use the same two hundred notes. Plans pin models, prompts, labels, and budgets. Offline replay reproduces scoring without new model calls.

engineering.title: Source selection improves; it is not perfect.
engineering.text: Using the frozen source labels, precision improves from thirty five point six percent to eighty six point four percent. The AI judge's correctness score improves from three point three seven to three point nine eight out of four. One baseline answer could not be graded.

engineering.title: Quality has a latency and token cost.
engineering.text: Local pipeline p ninety five increases from two point two two to three point two zero seconds. Verified inference costs about four dollars and seven cents per thousand questions at this case mix. The entire evaluation cost about one dollar and twenty two cents, including judging.

engineering.title: Related evidence is not sufficient evidence.
engineering.text: In one saved case, the verifier accepts a generic health note for the idiom under the weather. The judge also credits a disclosure that is absent. Shared models can make correlated mistakes. Frozen scores stay unchanged, with the audit alongside them.

engineering.title: Reproducible engineering, with clear limits.
engineering.text: The evidence demonstrates an implemented retrieval system, explicit failure handling, and a reproducible comparison. It does not establish learning gains or real user accuracy. Human review is pending, and the expanded corpus still needs coordinated production index publication.
